Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "folder", "box": [ 0.1044, 0.2242, 0.146372, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "SHARED STATE" }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.3022, 0.2242, 0.146372, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "PEER KNOWLEDGE" }, { "asset": "clock", "box": [ 0.5, 0.2242, 0.146372, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "TIME" }, { "asset": "gate", "box": [ 0.6978, 0.2242, 0.146372, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "ACCESS" } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** On the legal pad, many task arrows converge on small boxes labeled `SHARED STATE`, `PEER KNOWLEDGE`, `TIME`, and `ACCESS`. The boxes remain tools along routes to other goals.

**Action:** Curt redraws recurrence as a resource pattern.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> And they keep discovering the same kinds of prerequisites.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — dialogue and diagram express the project's instrumental-convergence interpretation.

", "title": "Tools lie along routes to separate goals" } }
